title: Senior Frontend Engineer

Founded banburyshire.com, a local guide and content platform: Rust compiled to WebAssembly on Cloudflare Workers, a custom PostgreSQL backend, a bespoke design system, and sigmx, my own micro frontend library, handling all client-side interactivity in under 10 kB
Ship production React, Next.js, Astro, Sanity and Craft CMS builds for founders, agencies and product teams, typically owning the frontend from architecture through to launch
Build content-heavy catalogue and marketing platforms with reusable component sets, editorial workflows and SEO-ready structure so non-technical editors can publish without engineering help
